messages:
Jules P: heads-up: bringing MarinaTech's LoRA merge into int3/quant eval. seeing subtle numeric skew on currency normalization (USD -> missing cents) in ~8% of cases. quick repro below.
Kai W: paste failing prompt?
Jules P: `Please generate receipt: Order 88, amount USD 123.45 ->`
Marisol B: interesting — int3? we've mostly used int4. did merge script use same weight folding codepath? any NaNs?
Jules P: no NaNs. ran fold check: mean/std look reasonable but logits for digits reduced magnitude in last layers on failing runs. fp16 baseline passes.
Kai W: run quickpack with `./evals/run_quickpack.sh --model marinatech/lora --quant int3 --suite numeric --batch 1 --ctx 4096 --dump-logits --dump-weight-stats` and also `--quant-presets=safe,aggressive` to compare.
Marisol B: add `--disable-gemms` and `--kv-warmup 3`. also try `--merge-method=add` vs `--merge-method=folded` since folding into int3 might need extra bias compensation.
Jules P: kicked off ci: ci/marinatech-int3-204 triggered by @Jules P (inference-eval:int3-canary)
ops-bot: ci/marinatech-int3-204 started — job/204 (docker: inference-eval:canary)
Jules P: log excerpt:
```
[prompt] Please generate receipt: Order 88, amount USD 123.45 ->
[tokenizer] ids: [501, 3002, ...]
[emit] "Please generate receipt: Order 88, amount USD 123"
[reason] stop_reason: eos
[logits] last_layer_mean: 0.0021 -> 0.00012 (failing)
```
Kai W: eos early + reduced logits magnitude — suggests quant scale mismatch. try `--quant-backend=hybrid-fallback` to run some layers in fp16 and see which layer flips.
Marisol B: also run a small 50-example quickpack I can share with customer: `quickpack_marinatech_currency_v1.zip` (will include notebook, reproducible commands for hosted/private). include instructions for canary routing: `--canary 3%` and metric `numeric-cents-preserved`.
Jules P: debug run uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/marinatech/204/traces.tar.gz
ops-bot: ci/marinatech-int3-204 completed: SUCCESS (artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/marinatech/204)
Kai W: plan: 1) add per-tensor post-fold bias adjust for int3 preset; 2) unit test folding+decode on currency tokens; 3) canary int3 at 1-3% with auto-fallback to fp16 if metric drops >2%.
Marisol B: I'll package the quickpack and notebook and share with MarinaTech engineering. Also updating rollout playbook and Optimize recommendations to flag currency-sensitive workloads.
Jules P: opening PR for bias-adjust patch + unit tests, will drop link here when ready. thanks all!
